question: Select the word with the correct spelling.
solution:
The correct answer is "**clinched**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word with the correct spelling is "**clinched**".
 
• Let's us look at all the options__:
 
• "**vivicity**" - This word is incorrect. The correct spelling is "**vivacity**" which means lively or animated.
 
 
• **Example**: Her vivacity and enthusiasm make her the life of the party.
 
 
 
• "**alergic**" - This word is incorrect. The correct spelling is "**allergic**", which is an adjective used to describe a hypersensitivity reaction to a particular allergen.
 
 
• **Example**: My friend is allergic to peanuts, so we always check food labels carefully.
 
 
 
• "**manteling**" - This word is incorrect. It could be a misspelling of "**mantling**", which is the action of a bird of prey spreading its wings over its prey. It can also refer to a covering or a cloak. 
 
 
• **Example**: After the eagle caught its prey, it began mantling to protect it. Example (mantel): The family photos are displayed on the mantel above the fireplace.
 
 
 
• "**clinched**" - This is the correctly spelled word. "**Clinched**" is the past tense of "**clinch**", which can mean to secure a deal or goal definitively, or to settle something decisively. It can also refer to a specific type of close grappling in boxing and wrestling.
 
 
• **Example**: With the last touchdown, they clinched the victory.
 
 
 
• Hence option 4 is correct.
